results.name: Third Peer Rejection (Strict 2-peer capacity enforcement)
results.trike_threat: T-04 (Penyusupan Pihak Ketiga ke Dalam Room / 3rd Peer Join)
results.expected_result: Peer 3 is rejected with a 'room_full' frame and WebSocket close code 1008 when attempting to join a room with 2 active peers.
results.actual_result: Peer 3 rejected with frame: {'type': 'room_full', 'reason': 'This room already has 2 participants.'}, close code: 1008
results.raw_evidence: room_id=e78c70e5-dd3a-40b7-9429-ced39bfc4bb4, peer1_connected=True, peer2_connected=True, peer3_response_frame={'type': 'room_full', 'reason': 'This room already has 2 participants.'}, ws_close_code=1008
results.limitation: Evaluated on signaling relay level in local test environment; does not evaluate browser endpoint compromise.

results.name: API Rate Limiting on POST /rooms (HTTP 429 enforcement)
results.trike_threat: T-13 (DoS Flooding Pembuatan Room / Resource Exhaustion)
results.expected_result: Sequential requests within a 1-minute window: requests 1-10 are accepted (HTTP 200), request 11 onwards returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
results.actual_result: Rate limit threshold strictly verified: exactly 10 requests accepted (HTTP 200), subsequent 6 requests returned HTTP 429 (total requests: 16).
results.limitation: Evaluated on single IP sequential bursts in local test harness; does not simulate distributed cloud botnets.

results.name: Oversized WebSocket Payload Rejection (MAX_MSG_BYTES 64 KB guard)
results.trike_threat: T-14 (Exhaustion Memori Melalui Frame WebSocket Raksasa)
results.security_req: SR-16 (MAX_MSG_BYTES 64 KB Payload Guard & Socket Close 1009)
results.expected_result: Sending a message payload exceeding MAX_MSG_BYTES (65,536 bytes) causes connection termination with WebSocket close code 1009.
results.actual_result: Oversized frame (65694 B) rejected with error frame: {'type': 'error', 'reason': 'Message exceeds 65536 byte limit.'}, close code: 1009
results.raw_evidence: room_id=9c56fdf2-d94d-40c0-9a59-5e57827d538a, payload_size_bytes=65694, max_limit=65536, error_frame={'type': 'error', 'reason': 'Message exceeds 65536 byte limit.'}, close_code=1009
results.limitation: Evaluated at single-frame size limit; does not evaluate continuous streaming fragmentation memory attacks.

results.name: Malformed WebSocket Message Handling (Crash Resilience & Input Sanitization)
results.trike_threat: T-14 (Exhaustion Memori / Server Crash via Malformed Input)
results.security_req: SR-16 (Robust JSON Parsing & Graceful Error Handling)
results.expected_result: Malformed frames (invalid JSON, empty object, missing type, invalid field types) are handled gracefully without server exception or crash; subsequent valid frames succeed.
results.actual_result: Server handled 4 malformed cases gracefully without crash and responded to ping with pong.
results.limitation: Evaluates structural payload resilience; does not substitute full RFC 6455 protocol-level fuzzing.

results.name: Explicit Room Destruction & Post-Destruction Reconnection Rejection
results.trike_threat: T-09 (Pengambilalihan Sesi Setelah Salah Satu Peer Keluar)
results.security_req: SR-11 (Instant Room Destruction & Memory Table Purging)
results.expected_result: Destroying room terminates all peer connections and rejects subsequent reconnection attempts with 'Room not found' (close code 1008).
results.actual_result: Room destroyed: Peer 2 received 'room_ended' frame (code: 1008); reconnect rejected with {'type': 'error', 'reason': 'Room not found or expired.'} (code: 1008).
results.raw_evidence: room_id=934ade68-b9b3-4eb7-8c4b-c9601973021c, peer2_room_ended=True, peer2_close_code=1008, reconnect_rejected=True, reconnect_frame={'type': 'error', 'reason': 'Room not found or expired.'}, reconnect_close_code=1008
results.limitation: Evaluates in-memory session cleanup; does not evaluate distributed memory cache synchronization across multiple nodes.

results.name: WebSocket Idle Timeout Disconnection (WS_IDLE_TIMEOUT Inactivity Guard)
results.trike_threat: T-14 (Exhaustion Memori Melalui Koneksi Idle / Zombie Sockets)
results.security_req: SR-16 (WebSocket Idle Timeout Disconnection & Socket Close 1001)
results.expected_result: An idle connection exceeding WS_IDLE_TIMEOUT (3.0s in test env) is terminated with close code 1001 and an inactivity timeout error frame.
results.actual_result: Idle connection closed after 3.00s with frame: {'type': 'error', 'reason': 'Connection closed due to inactivity.'}, close code: 1001
results.raw_evidence: room_id=56850f19-c012-4b3c-bfde-5420a49cdf8a, injected_timeout_threshold=3.0s, measured_elapsed=3.00s, timeout_frame={'type': 'error', 'reason': 'Connection closed due to inactivity.'}, close_code=1001
results.limitation: Injected 3.0s timeout in test harness; production environment uses 60.0s default timeout.
